title: Prove vector-cocycle call floors beyond scalar characters (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a vector-valued cocycle rank floor for formal rank-one register words, with arbitrary finite restored dirty workspace and interspersed constant scalar mixing. **Claim type: scoped algebraic proof with exact finite corroboration. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.**

```text
rho(T) = [[A(T), Delta_c(T)], [0, eps(T)]]
rank Delta_c(UV) <= rank Delta_c(U) + rank Delta_c(V)
one legal call contributes rank 1 exactly when c(g) != 0
```

This extends the first-order method to every split finite normal p-subgroup through its Frattini quotient, with an arbitrary complement action. The complement can be nonabelian and have order divisible by p. A sharp family Fp^d semidirect SL_d(Fp) has exact cost w for w nonzero translation targets, although every abelian quotient kills the entire translation target.

This answers the vector-valued extension in Sagar Thakrar / thakrarsagar PR4032 Open next question 2. Credit Cinna Davis PR2116/2047/2248/2085 for the formal register and first-order lineage, and Nick Petalas PR4898 for the earlier SL2(F3) instance and PR6008 for the full-operator representation rank cut. The new invariant is a common rectangular block with one-unit call charge even when a full operator defect has larger rank. Affine representations of cocycles and rank subadditivity are classical; no literature-wide priority is claimed. Existing mathematical results are cited premises and were not re-audited.

The proof and verifier were produced by Nick Petalas. Exact source pins and retained credit are in the package. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19360783). Canonical main was refreshed before commitment and remained 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. Live claims, local reservations, recent account work, merged/main-tree searches and cached complete-pagination overlap searches were checked. Unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain outside that coverage.

## Evidence

- Before: PR4032 explicitly leaves the normal-subgroup extension open. After: PROOF.md gives the rectangular product law, per-call rank charge, arbitrary-complement specialization and sharp family with full formal endpoints.
- Both normal and optimized checks pass 46,656 group pairs, 28,080 call images and inverses, 252 prefixes of 72 sampled words with interspersed scalar mixing, and 584 sharp formal target lists. The finite example is F3^2 semidirect SL2(F3), of order 216 with complement order 24. Finite checks do not establish the universal quantifiers.
- Seven semantic/domain controls pass. Three disposable code mutations reject ignored module action, uncharged nonzero-cocycle calls and an omitted translated target. The exclusive-output control preserves an existing receipt.
- Both registered checks pass locally on CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only. Direct normal/optimized commands took 2.57s and 2.39s; the complete registered replay took 5.13s. Each registered command has a 120-second timeout. These are check-duration observations.
- All six committed files, modes and declared source ancestry pass publication preflight. Official export and integrity checks pass. Both direct modes pass in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH; all seven exported files retain their hashes and both receipts match the checkout exactly. Source compilation, function bounds and whitespace checks pass.

Reproduce from the repository root, using the exact local interpreter or another CPython 3.12 installation:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/vector-cocycle-rank-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/vector-cocycle-rank-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/vector-cocycle-rank-floor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/vector-cocycle-rank-floor --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected output includes PASS_VECTOR_COCYCLE_RANK_FLOOR, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. The direct receipt is generated from exact computations and all six package hashes. No hand-written receipt is committed.

## Limitations

The cocycle floor is necessary, not sufficient; nonidentity elements in its kernel can remain invisible. Frattini defects and nonsplit extensions need additional arguments. Only the stated finite group, role domains and deterministic samples are computationally checked. The universal statement rests on the written proof, outside a formal kernel.

Native maps, scalar conversions, source access, ownership/erasure, physical restoration, hosting, precision/tape, compiler closure and complete signed supplier/outer bills remain unprovided. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker, heavy native builds and the selected scientific cold replay were not run. The five selected framework assumptions remain.

## Open next questions

- Can several cocycles give a strictly stronger joint weighted-call floor for one supplied alphabet and full endpoint? Start with its linear count constraints and a feasible dual witness. Native prices and a promising physical endpoint are missing.
- Can a second-order block invariant detect one Frattini defect with a justified per-call charge? Start with its exact block-product law. A suitable invariant is missing.

## Related open work

The completion refresh read this account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM. No additional computations were run to compare other results. The adjacent scopes are:

- [PR3893](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3893) studies a faithful-representation floor for one S3 endpoint; this package gives a general cocycle-block floor and computes no number for that endpoint.
- [PR3905](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3905) studies a fixed integer-shear endpoint through a formal word-ball obstruction; its alphabet and invariant differ and its endpoint is not computed here.
- [PR6403](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6403) studies weighted two-normal tariffs in binary semilinear groups; this package changes the invariant and complement hypotheses and computes no tariff for that object.
- [PR6410](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6410) studies central UT4 targets and weighted letter tariffs in a formal dirty-register model. It uses paired higher-order coefficient equations; this first-order cocycle floor computes no UT4 central tariff. No common numerical endpoint is compared.

It does not establish independent acceptance of the universal written proof or discharge native, physical, supplier or all-size obligations. ## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Six new files in one opt-in research package; shared code, frozen predecessor files and the selected frontier are unchanged.
